scripts.build: npm run build -w @thailab/shared && npm run build -w @thailab/server && npm run build -w @thailab/client
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @thailab/shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @thailab/server" "npm run dev -w @thailab/client"
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run start -w @thailab/server" "npm run start -w @thailab/client"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @thailab/shared && npm run lint -w @thailab/server && npm run lint -w @thailab/client
